text: The tool deliberately requires ESPHome 2026.1 or newer. When the entity-name web API URLs replaced object-id URLs, we considered supporting both schemes behind a version probe so older firmware kept working. The user was asked directly and said they do not care about older ESPHome, so the dual code path was dropped rather than written. Do not add a compatibility shim back without asking: the reason is a product decision, not an oversight. Note that object-id URLs still function today and only stop working in ESPHome 2026.7.0, so a future report of 404s on every write from someone on old firmware is expected behaviour, not a regression.
